text:
maya: Quick sync on CloudAtlas listing + joint webinar. Need owners for benchmark, landing copy, and routing. Two assets: 1) 1-page benchmark story + CSV 2) 45m webinar.

vik: I'll take the benchmark. Plan: 3 workloads (chat, summarization, search). Metrics: avg latency, p95, cost per 10k tokens. Will include CSV with columns: workload, model, avg_ms, p95_ms, tokens, usd_cost.

sam: I'll own webinar ops & registration page. Proposed format: 20m demo, 15m partner spotlight, 10m Q&A. Target week of May 15, dry run May 12.

olivia: I'll write marketplace copy + email subject lines. Two headline tests: A) "Inference that keeps apps fast and costs low" B) "Production inference for regulated apps". Recommend A for developer-facing, B for partner listing.

maya: Routing: use hidden form field partner=cloudatlas and utm_campaign=cloudatlas-launch. If partner==cloudatlas route to SFDC "Partners - Marketplace" queue; if lead.score>80 tag "high-priority". Sam please add mapping.

vik: Timeline: benchmark draft in 4 business days, CSV attached to the drive. Olivia send landing copy by Tue. Sam to confirm webinar date and lock Jenna for the partner case study.

maya: Assignments recap: Vik=benchmark, Olivia=copy, Sam=webinar & routing, Maya=partner comms. I'll create the folder and add deadlines. :thumbsup:
